name: tgm-planning-deploy
description: Build tooling for the Planning department's Vercel-hosted copy of ../index.html — extracts planning-only+shared+core via ../deploy-shared/extract.js, injects window.TGM_API_BASE + window.APP_DEPT='planning', minifies with terser. Not the deployed app itself; planning-deploy/public/index.html is what actually ships. Mirrors ../vercel-deploy (the Sales app's build tooling) — see that folder's build.js for the original pattern this was copied from.
